summary: This standard covers companies producing iron and steel in mills and foundries, including flat-rolled, pipe, tube and stainless products. It addresses greenhouse gas emissions, air quality, energy, water and waste, workforce health and safety, and the management of iron ore and coking coal sourcing risks.

questions.text: What is your organisation's gross global Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions, and what percentage of them is covered under emissions-limiting regulations?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) CO₂-e, Percentage (%) · Report gross global Scope 1 emissions in metric tonnes CO2-e and, separately, the percentage covered under emissions-limiting regulations (e.g. cap-and-trade or carbon tax schemes).

questions.text: What is your long- and short-term strategy or plan to manage Scope 1 emissions, what are your emissions reduction targets, and how have you performed against them?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the strategy or plan, the targets (scope, baseline year, target year), and an analysis of performance against those targets, including any activities or investments driving the change.

questions.text: What are your organisation's air emissions of the following pollutants: (1) CO, (2) NOx (excluding N2O), (3) SOx, (4) particulate matter (PM10), (5) manganese (MnO), (6) lead (Pb), (7) volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and (8) polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs)?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) · Report each pollutant separately in metric tonnes, covering all operations and noting estimation or measurement methods; state any pollutant that is not applicable.

questions.text: What is your organisation's (1) total energy consumed, (2) percentage grid electricity and (3) percentage renewable?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report each part: total energy consumed in gigajoules, plus the percentages listed, calculated against total energy consumed.

questions.text: What are your organisation's (1) total fuel consumed, (2) percentage coal, (3) percentage natural gas and (4) percentage renewable?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report total fuel consumed in gigajoules and the percentage that is coal, natural gas and renewable.

questions.text: What are your organisation's (1) total water withdrawn and (2) total water consumed, and what percentage of each is in regions with High or Extremely High Baseline Water Stress?
questions.hint: Unit: Thousand cubic metres (m³), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total water withdrawn and (2) total water consumed in thousand cubic metres, and the percentage of each in regions with High or Extremely High Baseline Water Stress (e.g. per the WRI Aqueduct tool).

questions.text: What are your organisation's (1) amount of waste generated, (2) percentage hazardous and (3) percentage recycled?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total waste generated in metric tonnes, (2) the percentage that is hazardous and (3) the percentage recycled.

questions.text: What are your (1) total recordable incident rate (TRIR), (2) fatality rate, and (3) near miss frequency rate (NMFR) for (a) direct employees and (b) contract employees?
questions.hint: Unit: Rate · Report each rate separately for (a) direct employees and (b) contract employees, stating the basis used (e.g. per 200,000 or 1,000,000 hours worked).

questions.text: What process do you use to manage iron ore or coking coal sourcing risks arising from environmental and social issues?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe how sourcing risks for iron ore or coking coal are identified and managed, including supplier screening, audits, standards and engagement.

questions.text: What was your organisation's raw steel production, and what percentage came from (1) basic oxygen furnace processes and (2) electric arc furnace processes?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t), Percentage (%) · Report raw steel production in metric tonnes and the percentage from (1) basic oxygen furnace and (2) electric arc furnace processes.

questions.text: What was your organisation's total iron ore production?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) · Report total iron ore production in metric tonnes for the reporting period.

questions.text: What was your organisation's total coking coal production?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) · Report total coking coal production in metric tonnes for the reporting period.
